changelog:
Bazi Pro 1.0.0 — Professional Bazi (Four Pillars) calculation and AI analysis skill

- Introduces a Node.js-based skill for Bazi calculation, including full Four Pillar and pattern analysis.
- Automatically provides detailed AI-powered Bazi interpretation; no `--interpret` flag needed (unless forcing); use `--no-interpret` for raw output.
- Ensures output is a fully formatted Markdown report—including an "AI Interpretation" section—without code blocks or reformatting.
- Supports DeepSeek and OpenAI for AI interpretation via environment variables; defaults to DeepSeek if configured.
- Offers both comprehensive analysis (lifetime, cycles) and calculation-only modes as per user request.
summary: Professional Bazi analysis skill. Invoke when user asks for "bazi", "fortune telling", "calculate bazi", "eight characters", or "interpret bazi".
